name: Rahden (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rahden (three blue flowers on white above crossed white hooks on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of 19 April 1973 the city was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a banner; the flag is red and white divided with the city shield shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Rahden arms — flowers and crossed hooks
